H0175.name: Aaron
H0175.desc: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0175.brief: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel
H0175.short: Aaron was Moses' older brother and served as the first high priest of Israel.

H0118.name: Adalia
H0118.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0118.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
H0118.short: Adalia was one of the ten sons of Haman, the enemy of the Jews, who was killed along with his brothers.
H0118.meaning: “I shall be drawn up of Jah”

forms.meaning: “I shall be drawn up of Jah”

H0121G.name: Adam
H0121G.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H0121G.brief: The first man, created by God
H0121G.short: Adam, the first man created by God, sinned and brought death into the world, but through Christ, the last Adam, came life and resurrection.

H0110.name: Adbeel
H0110.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0110.brief: Son of Ishmael, grandson of Abraham
H0110.short: Adbeel was a son of Ishmael and a grandson of Abraham, likely representing an Arab tribe or clan.

H0146H.name: Addar
H0146H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0146H.short: Addar, also known as Ard, was a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin.

H0133.name: Admatha
H0133.desc: Prince living at the time of Exile and Return
H0133.brief: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media
H0133.short: Admatha was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had access to King Ahasuerus's presence and held the highest positions in the kingdom.

H0137.name: Adoni-bezek
H0137.brief: Canaanite king captured and mutilated by Judah
H0137.short: Adoni-bezek was a Canaanite king who was defeated by the men of Judah, and had his thumbs and big toes cut off as he had done to seventy other kings.

H0138H.name: Adonijah
H0138H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0138H.brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
H0138H.short: Adonijah was one of the Levites King Jehoshaphat sent to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

H0138G.name: Adonijah
H0138G.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H0138G.brief: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne
H0138G.short: Adonijah, the fourth son of David, declared himself king when David was old, but Solomon was chosen to succeed David instead, and Adonijah was later put to death for his rebellious actions.

H0138I.name: Adonijah
H0138I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0138I.brief: Levite who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
H0138I.short: Adonijah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

H0140.name: Adonikam
H0140.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0140.brief: Jewish exile whose descendants returned to Jerusalem
H0140.short: Adonikam was one of the Jewish exiles whose descendants returned to Jerusalem from Babylon, as recorded in the lists in Ezra and Nehemiah.

H0139.name: Adoni-zedek
H0139.brief: King of Jerusalem who fought against Joshua
H0139.short: Adoni-zedek, the king of Jerusalem, formed an alliance with other Amorite kings to fight against Joshua and the Israelites but was defeated and killed.

H0151.name: Adoram
H0151.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0151.brief: Official in charge of forced labor under David and Solomon
H0151.short: Adoram, also known as Adoniram or Hadoram, was an official in charge of forced labor during the reigns of David, Solomon, and Rehoboam.

H0152G.name: Adrammelech
H0152G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0152G.brief: Assyrian god worshipped by Sepharvites in Samaria
H0152G.short: Adrammelech was an Assyrian deity worshipped by the Sepharvite people.
H0152G.meaning: “honour of the king” or “Adar is prince” or “Adar is Counsellor, Decider”

forms.meaning: “honour of the king” or “Adar is prince” or “Adar is Counsellor, Decider”

H0152H.name: Adrammelech
H0152H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0152H.brief: Son of Sennacherib who murdered his father
H0152H.short: Adrammelech, son of Assyrian king Sennacherib, assassinated his father.
H0152H.meaning: “honour of the king” or “Adar is prince” or “Adar is Counsellor, Decider”

forms.meaning: “honour of the king” or “Adar is prince” or “Adar is Counsellor, Decider”

H0164H.name: Ehud
H0164H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0164H.short: Ehud, a Benjamite, was one of the sons of Bilhan.
H0164H.meaning: “I will give thanks: I will be praised” or “undivided, union” in (

forms.meaning: “I will give thanks: I will be praised” or “undivided, union” in (

H0164G.name: Ehud
H0164G.brief: Left-handed Benjamite judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression
H0164G.short: Ehud, a left-handed Benjamite, was a judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression by assassinating King Eglon and leading a victory over Moab.
H0164G.meaning: “I will give thanks: I will be praised” or “undivided, union” in (

forms.meaning: “I will give thanks: I will be praised” or “undivided, union” in (

H0189.name: Evi
H0189.desc: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0189.brief: Midianite king killed in battle against Israel.
H0189.short: Evi was one of the Midianite kings killed by the Israelites during the time of Moses.

H0192.name: Evil-merodach
H0192.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0192.brief: King of Babylon; released Jehoiachin from prison.
H0192.short: Evil-merodach was a king of Babylon who released Jehoiachin, the former king of Judah, from prison.

H0112.name: Iddo
H0112.desc: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
H0112.brief: A prophet in Casiphia during Ezra's time.
H0112.short: Iddo was a prophet in Casiphia to whom Ezra sent a message requesting Levites to assist in the temple service.

H0179.name: Obil
H0179.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0179.short: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of King David's camels.

H0161.name: Ohad
H0161.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0161.short: Ohad was one of the sons of Simeon, as listed in the genealogies.

H0169.name: Ohel
H0169.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0169.short: Ohel was a descendant of Judah through the line of Zerubbabel.

H0170.name: Oholah
H0170.desc: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
H0170.short: Oholah was a symbolic name given to Samaria, representing the northern kingdom of Israel in Ezekiel's prophecy.

H0171.name: Oholiab
H0171.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0171.short: Oholiab was a skilled craftsman from the tribe of Dan who was appointed to work on the construction of the tabernacle.

H0172.name: Oholibah
H0172.desc: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
H0172.short: Oholibah was a symbolic name given to Jerusalem, representing the southern kingdom of Judah in Ezekiel's prophecy.
H0172.meaning: “woman of the tent” or “the tent is in her”

forms.meaning: “woman of the tent” or “the tent is in her”

H0173.name: Oholibamah
H0173.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0173.short: Oholibamah was one of Esau's wives, a descendant of Seir the Horite.

H0177.name: Uel
H0177.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0177.brief: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
H0177.short: Uel was one of the Israelites who agreed to put away his foreign wife during the time of Ezra's reforms.

H0198G.name: Ulam
H0198G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0198G.brief: Son of Sheresh, great-grandson of Manasseh
H0198G.short: Ulam was a son of Sheresh and great-grandson of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh.

H0198H.name: Ulam
H0198H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0198H.brief: Descendant of Benjamin, known for his numerous descendants
H0198H.short: Ulam was a descendant of Benjamin known for his numerous descendants, including many skilled archers.

H0186.name: Uzai
H0186.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0186.brief: Father of Palal, who repaired Jerusalem's wall
H0186.short: Uzai was the father of Palal, who helped repair Jerusalem's wall.

H0187G.name: Uzal
H0187G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0187G.brief: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
H0187G.short: Uzal, a descendant of Shem, was one of Joktan's sons.

H0121H.name: Adam
H0121H.brief: A city near the Jordan River.
H0121H.short: Adam, a city beside the Jordan, where the river was stopped for Israel's crossing.

H0128.name: Adamah
H0128.brief: A fortified city allotted to Naphtali.
H0128.short: Adamah, a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali.

H0129.name: Adami-nekeb
H0129.brief: A boundary marker for the territory of Naphtali.
H0129.short: Adami-nekeb, a place marking the border of Naphtali's territory.

H0135.name: Addan
H0135.brief: A place from which some returned exiles came.
H0135.short: Addan (Addon), a place from which some Jewish exiles returned to Judah.

H0146G.name: Addar
H0146G.brief: A boundary marker for the territory of Judah.
H0146G.short: Addar, a place on the southern border of Judah's territory.

H0126.name: Admah
H0126.brief: One of the cities destroyed with Sodom and Gomorrah.
H0126.short: Admah, one of the "cities of the plain" destroyed along with Sodom and Gomorrah.

H0115.name: Adoraim
H0115.brief: A fortified city built by Rehoboam in Judah.
H0115.short: Adoraim, one of the cities fortified by King Rehoboam in Judah.

H0131.name: Adummim
H0131.brief: A pass on the border between Judah and Benjamin.
H0131.short: Adummim, a mountain pass on the boundary between Judah and Benjamin.

H0163.name: Ahava
H0163.brief: A place where Ezra assembled the returning exiles.
H0163.short: Ahava, a location near Babylon where Ezra gathered the exiles before their return to Jerusalem.

H0123G.name: Edom
H0123G.brief: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel
H0123G.short: Edom, a nation descended from Esau that was often in conflict with Israel.

H0154.name: Edrei
H0154.brief: Amorite city defeated by Moses and the Israelites
H0154.short: Edrei, an Amorite city east of the Jordan defeated by the Israelites under Moses.

H0197H.name: Hall of Judgment
H0197H.brief: A hall in Solomon's palace where he administered justice.
H0197H.short: The Hall of Judgment was a hall in Solomon's palace where he sat to judge and administer justice (<ref="1Ki.7.7">1Ki.7.7</ref>).

H0197G.name: Hall of Pillars
H0197G.brief: A porch with pillars in Solomon's palace.
H0197G.short: The Hall of Pillars was a porch in Solomon's palace, measuring fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide, with a portico of pillars and a canopy.

H0197I.name: Hall of the Throne
H0197I.brief: Another name for the Hall of Judgment in Solomon's palace.
H0197I.short: The Hall of the Throne was another name for the Hall of Judgment in Solomon's palace, where he sat to administer justice (<ref="1Ki.7.7">1Ki.7.7</ref>).

H0195.name: Ulai
H0195.brief: A river in Elam, near where Daniel saw a vision
H0195.short: Ulai, a river in Elam, near Susa, where Daniel received a vision of a ram and a goat (<ref="Dan. 8:2, 16">Dan. 8:2, 16</ref>).

H0187H.name: Uzal
H0187H.brief: A place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
H0187H.short: Uzal, a place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy, possibly referring to a region in Arabia known for its high-quality swords (<ref="Ezek. 27:19">Ezek. 27:19</ref>).

H0143.name: Adar
H0143.brief: The twelfth month of the Hebrew religious calendar
H0143.short: Adar was the twelfth month of the Hebrew religious calendar, in which the feast of Purim was celebrated .
